observations: Photo 0 shows a stack of at least 10 silver laptops, closed, with a yellow sticky note on top. The top laptop has a small HP logo and a barcode sticker. The background includes product boxes (Samsung, Xbox controller).

Photo 1 shows the top laptop open, displaying a black screen. The keyboard is black with white lettering. The HP logo is visible on the bezel below the screen. The palm rest has a sticker with 'ELITEBOOK' and a Windows logo. The laptop is sitting on the stack of closed laptops.

Photo 2 shows the same stack from a side angle, with the top laptop open at an angle. The side ports are visible: USB-C, HDMI, and possibly a headphone jack. The background includes a sign with 'KORRECT GADGET' and 'Correct Device'.

claims.claim: Uk Uses Hp Elitebook 1040 G8 core i7 32gig Ram 512gig SSD
claims.evidence: The model name is supported by the sticker in photo 1 and seller text, but the CPU, RAM, and SSD specs are not visible in any photo. No system information or internal shots are provided.

risks.risk: The laptop may not have the advertised specs (Core i7, 32GB RAM, 512GB SSD)
risks.proof: A photo of the BIOS screen, system information, or a screenshot from Windows showing the CPU, RAM, and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-spec model (e.g., Core i5, 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD) or as not matching the advertised specs.

risks.risk: The laptop may be damaged or have cosmetic defects not visible in the photos (e.g., screen dead pixels, keyboard issues, hinge problems)
risks.proof: A video showing the laptop being turned on, keyboard typing, screen brightness, and hinge movement.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential cosmetic or functional issues, reducing value.

risks.risk: The stack may contain multiple units, but only one is being sold, or the unit being sold is not the top one shown (which may be a demo or different condition)
risks.proof: A clear photo or video showing the specific unit being sold, with a unique identifier (serial number) visible and matching the one being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a single unit, but with uncertainty about which one, reducing trust and value.

proof_requests: Photo or video of the BIOS or system information screen showing CPU, RAM, and SSD specs.
Video of the laptop turning on, keyboard typing, and screen display.
Photo of the serial number sticker on the bottom of the laptop being sold.
response.reason: The model is identifiable as an HP EliteBook 1040 G8, but the advertised specs (Core i7, 32GB RAM, 512GB SSD) cannot be verified from the photos. There are also hidden risks regarding condition and which unit is being sold. Proof is needed to confirm the specs and condition before pricing.
